# Swag Stree

> Premium fashion e-commerce store in India — kurtas, coord sets, sarees, streetwear & accessories.

## Store
- Website: dynamic origin (swagstree Cloudflare Workers deployment)
- Brand: Swag Stree / Swagstree
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/swag_stree
- WhatsApp: +91 8800467686
- Support email: support@swagstree.com

## Shopping
- Payment: COD (cash on delivery), UPI, Paytm, Google Pay
- Delivery: across India
- Product URLs: `/?id={productId}`

## Catalog
- Live product feed: `/sitemap-products.xml`
- Product pages support deep links with variant params: `?id=&color=&size=`

## Policies
- Customers can add delivery instructions at checkout and edit until order ships
- Guest checkout supported; order tracking via account email
